name: sled-press
instructions:
1. Load the desired weight onto the sled and attach a set of handles with a nylon strap.
2. Setup in a split stance athletic position with your body inclined away from the sled at roughly 45 degrees and your arms loaded by your torso.
3. Press the handles away from your torso by extending the arms.
4. Take a few steps forward until you again have sufficient tension on the handles.
5. Repeat until you reach the desired number of repetitions, distance, or time.
